schemas.orders:
<xs:schema xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema">
  <xs:element name="orders"><xs:complexType><xs:sequence><xs:element ref="order" maxOccurs="unbounded"/></xs:sequence></xs:complexType></xs:element>
  <xs:element name="order"><xs:complexType><xs:sequence>
    <xs:element name="customer" type="xs:string"/>
    <xs:element name="item" maxOccurs="unbounded"><xs:complexType>
      <xs:attribute name="sku" type="xs:string" use="required"/>
      <xs:attribute name="qty" type="xs:positiveInteger" use="required"/>
      <xs:attribute name="price" type="xs:decimal" use="required"/>
    </xs:complexType></xs:element>
  </xs:sequence><xs:attribute name="no" type="xs:int" use="required"/></xs:complexType></xs:element>
</xs:schema>

cases.question: The names of the funds in EUR.
The id of the fund with the highest NAV.
The total number of shares of all funds.
The reporting date of the document.
How many orders did Ada place?
The total quantity of SKU A over all orders.
The order numbers that contain more than one item.
The titles of books with more than one author.
The title of the newest book.
The value of each order (sum of qty times price), one number per order in document order.
The distinct customer names, sorted alphabetically.
For each author the number of books, as text lines 'name: count' sorted by name.
The market value (nav times shares) of all funds together, rounded to two decimals.

cases.notes: One entry per fund with its name.
a = order number, b = order value (sum of qty times price).
